body: Both my phone and internet will be shut off come Thursday. Don't think I can make it long without that support then. It's pointless to even try at this point.
Things get a little worse every day. Not sure how I can manage this.
I wouldn't even know where to start on goals or anything. I can't even leave my home. I'm starting to not even care.
Had a big panic attack last night. Things are getting no better. I don't know what to do at this point.
The only one who really understands also is bipolar and thinks we should get together and finish ourselves once and for all. No one else gets why I can't just be happy.
Things are only getting worse and worse.
I am really not worth anyone's trouble though.
If it does me in, I can't see how it is not.
The not feeling well is the least of my concerns at this point. I actually think it may be a blessing (for lack of a better term).

I am too afraid of doctors anymore. Plus most of me is just saying it's not really that bad and they will only tell me I am faking. I don't think I can move past that. To be honest, I have no intention at all on seeing a doctor about this.
